week4.soi: The network’s collection, warehousing and delivery service that moves donated food from donors to partner pantries.

requirements.name: Produce until closing
requirements.statement: The delivery service shall keep fresh produce on the shelves of each partner pantry until at least 30 minutes before its closing time on every distribution day.

requirements.name: Cold-chain limit
requirements.statement: The network shall keep donated food at or below 5 °C from collection to delivery.

requirements.name: Shortfall notice
requirements.statement: The delivery service shall notify the pantry coordinator of any shortfall in an order before the delivery leaves the warehouse.

requirements.name: Freezer alarm time
requirements.statement: The network shall alert the on-call warehouse staff to a freezer temperature above the alarm limit (TBD-01) within 5 minutes, at any hour.

requirements.name: Shift length
requirements.statement: The delivery service shall end every volunteer delivery shift within 2 hours of its start.

requirements.name: Reach report to funders
requirements.statement: The network shall provide the delivered weight per county district to each funder every quarter.

requirements.name: Freezer sampling interval
requirements.statement: The temperature monitoring function shall sample each freezer temperature at intervals of no more than 60 s.

requirements.name: Route fits the shift
requirements.statement: The routing tool shall plan each delivery route so that its planned duration fits within the driver’s shift.

requirements.name: Van cargo temperature
requirements.statement: The refrigerated vans shall hold their cargo at or below 5 °C for a delivery round of up to 3 hours.

requirements.name: Funder report export
requirements.statement: The reporting function shall export the delivered weight per district in the funders’ spreadsheet template.

risks.name: Cold plates too short in summer heat
Alarm settings changed through the shared account
Weekend power cut at the warehouse
Planned routes shorter than real ones

physical.name: Freezer sensors and alarm gateway
physical.text: Battery sensors in each freezer and a cellular gateway.

physical.name: Refrigerated vans
physical.text: Four vans with refrigeration units and volunteer drivers.

physical.name: Pantry refrigerators
physical.text: One refrigerator at each partner pantry (the Week 3 decision).

physical.name: Scheduling and reporting software
physical.text: The coordinator’s cloud scheduling tool with route planning.

physical.name: Warehouse dock and workshop
physical.text: Loading dock, volunteers and the technician’s workshop.

requirements.name: Failure warning delivery
requirements.statement: The alarm gateway shall deliver each failure warning to the scheduling software over IF-006 within 2 min of detection.
requirements.criterion: every warning received within 2 min in 20 injected failures
requirements.rationale: A warning that arrives late cannot save the stock.

requirements.name: Quarterly upload
requirements.statement: The scheduling software shall upload the quarterly reach report to the county portal over IF-003 within five working days of quarter end.
requirements.criterion: upload confirmed within five working days

requirements.name: No client names to the AI service
requirements.statement: The scheduling software shall not send any client name to the OpenAI API over IF-009.
requirements.criterion: no client name in 50 logged requests

standards: none: every interface follows its provider’s published format
